items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: And then he'd add now... Willie Phillips with his trumpet pair.

ctx.x: a great big bag of stuff, a basket of stuff.

Gives to them people, they'd stir it up, you know, and get a meal off it. Well, that's called them Portrait's Market Dan. He'd help out a whole lot of people. And he'd go down and scrape that stand for them butchers, and they'd give them leftover meat, you know, all's in there. They'd put it in a box or something like that, and he'd get back then and give them people, underprivileged people. And he stayed in a little... Oh man, half of this would be... his two rooms. Mm-hmm. And stool and then his bed, you know,…
Who else would he hire? Cook Chapson.
